title: Payment Methods API
description: The Payment Methods API enables you to add, manage, and remove additional payments methods offered by Surfboard. While the CARD is the default payment method, these APIs allows for the addition and removal of other payment methods such as AMEX and SWISH. These payment methods can be added to specific merchants and/or stores, offering versatility in payment strategies.

endpoints.fragment: Activate Payment Method for a Store

apis.heading: Activate Payment Method
apis.description: Activates multiple payment methods for a merchant in a single request. Each payment method can be enabled with a boolean value or configured with specific settings using an object.

reqParams.name: storeId
reqParams.description: Optional store identifier to associate payment methods with a specific store.

reqParams.name: merchantId
reqParams.description: Optional merchant identifier for the payment method configuration.

reqParams.name: terminalId
reqParams.description: Optional terminal (checkout) identifier to associate the payment methods with a specific terminal.

reqParams.name: card
reqParams.description: Card payment method configuration. Set to true to enable card payments, or pass an object with a scheme array (visa, mastercard) to configure it in detail.

reqParams.name: amex
reqParams.description: American Express payment method configuration. Set to true to enable AMEX payments, or pass an object with the AMEX merchant id (mId) to configure it.

reqParams.name: swish
reqParams.description: Swedish mobile payment method configuration. Set to true to enable Swish payments.

reqParams.name: klarna
reqParams.description: Buy now, pay later payment method configuration. Set to true to enable Klarna payments.

reqParams.name: b2binv
reqParams.description: B2B invoice payment method configuration. Set to true to enable B2B invoice payments.

reqParams.name: acc2acc
reqParams.description: Account to account transfer payment method configuration. Set to true to enable account to account transfers.

reqParams.name: vipps
reqParams.description: Norwegian mobile payment method. Set to true to enable Vipps payment method.

reqParams.name: mobilepay
reqParams.description: Danish mobile payment method. Set to true to enable MobilePay payment method.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Array of payment method registration results.

resParams.name: method
resParams.description: The payment method name (e.g., 'amex', 'swish', 'card').

resParams.name: paymentMethodId
resParams.description: Unique identifier assigned to the payment method (present on success).

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Registration status for this payment method, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: Error message if registration failed (present on error).

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the overall status of the request.

request.body:
{
	"card": true,
	"amex": true,
	"swish": true,
	"klarna": true,
	"b2binv": true,
	"acc2acc": true,
	"vipps": true,
	"mobilepay": true
}

apis.heading: Activate Payment Method for a Store
apis.description: Activates a single payment method for a specific store under a merchant. Only AMEX and SWISH can be activated at the store level; the store is taken from the URL path. Configuration values such as the AMEX merchant id or Swish number can be supplied alongside the payment method.

reqParams.name: paymentMethod
reqParams.description: The payment method to activate for the store. Only AMEX and SWISH are accepted at the store level.

reqParams.name: amexMID
reqParams.description: American Express merchant id, required when activating the AMEX payment method.

reqParams.name: swishNumber
reqParams.description: The Swish payee number to route Swish payments to, used when activating the SWISH payment method.

reqParams.name: acquirerMID
reqParams.description: Acquirer merchant id to associate with the payment method.

reqParams.name: username
reqParams.description: Provider username used when the payment method requires provider credentials.

reqParams.name: password
reqParams.description: Provider password used when the payment method requires provider credentials.

reqParams.name: klarnaMerchantId
reqParams.description: Klarna merchant id to associate with the payment method.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Array of payment method registration results for the store.

resParams.name: method
resParams.description: The payment method name that was processed (e.g., 'amex', 'swish').

resParams.name: paymentMethodId
resParams.description: Unique identifier assigned to the payment method (present on success).

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Registration status for this payment method, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: Error message if registration failed (present on error).

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the overall status of the request.

apis.heading: Deactivate Payment Method
apis.description: Deactivates a specific payment method. Use this API to deactivate the payment method added to the merchant or store using its Payment Method ID.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch Payment Method Details
apis.description: Retrieves information for a specific payment method. Use this API to get information regarding the payment method using its Payment Method ID.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Response data

resParams.name: paymentMethodId
resParams.description: PaymentMethod ID of the payment method.

resParams.name: paymentMethod
resParams.description: Specifies the payment method. It can be one of the following: 'AMEX', 'SWISH', or 'CARD’.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the payment method, indicated as either ACTIVATED' or 'DEACTIVATED’.

resParams.name: amexMID
resParams.description: Returns AMEX MID for AMEX payment method.

resParams.name: acquirerMID
resParams.description: Returns the respective Acquirer MID for CARD payment method.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch All Payment Methods
apis.description: Retrieves a list of all payment methods activated for a specific merchant. You can use this API to get information regarding all the payment methods added for the merchant.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Response data

resParams.name: paymentMethodId
resParams.description: PaymentMethod ID of the payment method.

resParams.name: paymentMethod
resParams.description: Specifies the payment method. It can be one of the following: 'AMEX', 'SWISH', or 'CARD’.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Fetch Payment Methods with Status
apis.description: Retrieves every payment method configured for a merchant, including each method's activation status. Use this when you need to see both active and deactivated payment methods, for example to build a settings screen.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The payment methods configured for the merchant.

resParams.name: paymentMethodId
resParams.description: PaymentMethod ID of the payment method.

resParams.name: paymentMethod
resParams.description: Specifies the payment method, for example 'AMEX', 'SWISH', or 'CARD'.

resParams.name: paymentStatus
resParams.description: Activation status of the payment method, indicated as either 'ACTIVATED' or 'DEACTIVATED'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: List Payment Methods
apis.description: Retrieves every payment method configured for a merchant along with its activation status. This is an alias of the Fetch Payment Methods with Status endpoint and returns the same response.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The payment methods configured for the merchant.

resParams.name: paymentMethodId
resParams.description: PaymentMethod ID of the payment method.

resParams.name: paymentMethod
resParams.description: Specifies the payment method, for example 'AMEX', 'SWISH', or 'CARD'.

resParams.name: paymentStatus
resParams.description: Activation status of the payment method, indicated as either 'ACTIVATED' or 'DEACTIVATED'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
